subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Land Rover engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the Ford EcoBoost across its Land Rover applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The EcoBoost appears in three Land Rover models — Discovery Sport, Freelander and Range Rover Evoque — all as the Si4 petrol variant.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with turbocharger and direct-injection system components inspected and assessed for condition.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The EcoBoost is known for timing chain stretch — rattling at startup is a telltale sign. Turbocharger issues and carbon buildup on intake valves are also common on higher-mileage examples, characteristic of direct-injection engines. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement. typical.title: LAND ROVER Ford EcoBoost REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The EcoBoost's timing chain is a known wear point — chains can stretch prematurely, causing rattling at startup and incorrect timing. On higher-mileage examples, the turbocharger is inspected for wear, and the direct-injection system is assessed for carbon buildup on intake valves. A full rebuild also includes inspection of the PCV system and high-pressure fuel pump.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, plus turbo and direct-injection system inspection
